upaddava.p: [Upa+du+a] (pu) CL=7 [Upagantvā dunotīti upaddavo. Du-paritāpe, a. Dhāna,ṭī.401.(upadrava-saṃ)] The nature that approaches and afflicts. Misfortune or risk. Upaddava(pu) [upa+du+a. Dhāna,ṭī,401. Upa+du+aṇa. Bhusaṃ daviti hiṃsatīti upaddavo. Nirutti. 538.] The nature that approaches and afflicts. Misfortune or risk. A harm that causes non-beneficial matter.
a: ဥပဂန္တွာ ဒုနောတီတိ ဥပဒ္ဒဝေါ။ ဒု-ပရိတာပေ၊အ။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ။၎ဝ၁။(ဥပဒြဝ-သံ)] ကပ်၍နှိပ်စက်တတ်သော သဘော၊ ဘေးဥပဒ်-ဘေးရန် အန္တရာယ်။ upaddava ဥပဒ္ဒဝ(ပု) [ဥပ+ဒု+အ။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ၊၎ဝ၁။ ဥပ+ဒု+အဏ်။ ဘုသံ ဒဝိတိ ဟိံသတီတိ ဥပဒ္ဒဝေါ။ နိရုတ္တိ။ ၅၃၈။] ကပ်၍ နှိက်စက်တတ်သောသဘော၊ ဘေးဥပဒ်၊ ဘေးရန်၊ အန္တရာယ်၊ အကျိုးမဲ့ကို ဖြစ်စေသောဘေးရန်။

DOP: upaddava m. [ S. upadrava], a sudden or grievous accident, calamity, misfortune; violence, oppression ; Abh 401; M III 61, 11 (ye keci ~ā uppajjanti sabbe te bālato uppajjanti no paṇḍitato); Sn 51 (ītī ca gaṇḍo ca ~o ca); Ja I 298, 10 (sā mayhaṃ kataraṃ nāma ~aṃ na kareyya); V 367, 5* (soko rogo c’ ~o); Nidd I 140, 9 (upaghātaṃ pīḷanaṃ ghaṭṭanaṃ ~aṃ upasaggaṃ brūhi; Nidd-a I 263, 6 : ~an ti hiṃsanaṃ); Paṭis II 239, 11 (pañcakkhandhe ~ato passanto); Mil 149, 15 (so tena rogena dukkhito ~ā parimuccitukāmo); Vism 235, 15 (tesaṃ pi ~ānaṃ nipātena); Spk I 150, 10 (uppannesu ~esu); Mhv 14:37 (~o nu atthī ti); — ifc see cor’-; — anupaddava , mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) free from misfortune or accident; safe; undamaged ; Vin III 162, 20 (disā abhayā anītikā ~ā); M III 61, 22 (sa-upaddavo bālo ~o paṇḍito); Dhp 338 (mūle ~e daḷhe); Ap 308, 2 (~o anīti ca homi apacito sadā); Mil 304, 9 (so aggi vuccati anītiko ~o samaye nibbuto nāmā ti); — 2. ( n. ) freedom from misfortune; safety ; Nidd I 443, 11 (khemaṃ passati sabbadhī ti … sabbattha ~aṃ passati sabbattha anupasaggaṃ passati …); Sp 1059, 22 (~’-atthāya); Dhp-a III 293, 10 (~ena dūraṭṭhānato āgataṃ); Ud-a 156, 31 (bhogānaṃ jīvitassa ca ~aṃ passitvā); — nirupaddava , mfn. , free from misfortune; safe ; Ja IV 139, 2 (nāvā satta divasāni ~ā agamāsi); Mil 323, 25 (anītito ~ato abhayato); 330, 19 (~aṃ anavajjaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ anuviloketvā); Sp 1154, 27* foll. (yathā ca vaṇṇanā esā samattā ~ā evaṃ sabbe janā santiṃ pappontu ~aṃ); Spk I 275, 15 (kheman ti abhayaṃ ~aṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee wr niruppadavaṃ; Se nirūpaddavaṃ); Pj I 179, 13 (sotthi hotu … arogatā ~-tā ti); — sa-upaddava , mfn. , subject to calamity; unsafe, dangerous ; Vin II 79, 3 (disā sabhayā sa-ītikā ~ā); M III 61, 22 (~o bālo); Sp 569, 8 (sārambhaṃ anārambhan ti ~aṃ anupaddavaṃ); Th-a I 207, 26 (maggo ca ~o); — sopaddava , mfn. , unsafe ; ~aṃ, adv. , in danger; not safely ; Mp III 411, 22 ([dukkhaṃ viharati] savighātan ti sa-upaghātaṃ ~aṃ); Ap-a 513, 20 (kucchitapathe ~-magge); — see also akutoci-upaddava.
CPD: upaddava , m. [ sa. upadrava], danger, calamity, nuisance, misfortune, injury ( syn. īti, upasagga, bhaya etc. ); Abh 401 (īti . . . ajaññaṃ ca upasaggo ~o); Nidd ll 110, 3 s. v. upakkilesa; upaddavatī ti ~o, anatthañ janento abhibhavati ajjhoharatī ti attho, rāja-daṇḍâdīnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, Pj ll 100, 21 ; expl. pariklesa (S l 132, 30* ), Spk l 192, 19 ; — ītī ca gaṇḍo ca ~o ca rogo ca sallañ ca bhayañ ca . . . etaṃ bhayaṃ kāma-guṇesu disvā, Sn 51 = Ap 10, 5-8 ; esā ( woman ) . . . soko rogo c' ~o, Ja V 367, 5* ( quoted ll 330, 19 '); yāni kānici bhayāni ... ye keci ~ā . . . ye keci upasagga uppajjanti, sabbāni tāni (sabbe te) bālato uppajjanti, no paṇḍitato . . . n'atthi paṇḍitato bhayaṃ n'atthi paṇḍitato ~o, n. p. upasaggo, M lll 61, 10 foll. = A l 101, 7 foll. partly quoted Pj l 127, 10 foll. (~o ti anek'aggatakaro, Ps lV 102, 22 = Mp ll 167, 4 ); — listed Paṭis ll 238, 9 with īti, bhaya, upa- sagga, Nidd l 138, 4 with roga, gaṇḍa, salla, 381, 8 with īti, roga, sūla, visūcikā, pajjaraka, pakkhandikā, 406, 15 ≠ 409, 3 with ubbega, uttrāsa, bhaya, bhīlana, ghaṭana, upasagga; three ~: tīhi ~ehi upaddutā mānusī pajā, Pj l 168, 2 ( cf. 161, 13 : tīhi dubbhikkha- amanussa-roga-bhayehi upaddutāya Vesāliyā); Ka- liṅga-raṭṭhaṃ dubbhikkha-bhayena chātaka-bhayena roga-bhayena ca upaddutaṃ, so ~o upasamissati, Cp-a 37, 9 ; four ~: soka, parideva, dukkha, doma- nassa, Ps l 237, 6 ; par'ūpavāda-vippaṭisāra-vadha- bandhâdayo e'eva apāya-dukkha-bhūtā nāna-ppa- kārā ~ā, Mp ll 183, 24 ; dīgha-jātito ( snakes ) vā ~o, Dhp-a lll 322, 9 = 324, 6 ; catusu paccayesu adhi- matta-chanda-rāgo ~o, Spk ll 174, 18 ; koci ~o bha- vissati, Ps lll 294, 20 ; kadāci koci ~o jāyissati, Att l 9 (p. 2, 17 ); °-dvaya (ācariy'ū~, ses'ū~), Ps lV 165, 18; — ifc. akat'ū ~-nivāraṇa (Pj ll 33, 11 ), akutoci- °, ananta-dos' °, ananto ° (Saddh 398), an- °, ante- vās'ū °, amanuss'ū °, ācariy'ū °, kiles'u ° (Ps lV 165, 7 ), cor' ° (Spk l 132, 19 ), dukkh' ° (Dhp-a lll 324, 3 ), nir ° (Mil 323, 25 ), nir~tā (Pj l 179, 13 ), niran- taro~tā (Ud-a 208, 20 ), paro ° (Saddh 267), brah- macariy'ū ° (M lll 115, 30 ), brahmacār'ū ° (M lll 115, 30 ), vigata-īti-bhay'ū ° (Pj ll 319, 21 ), sa- ° (Vin ll 79, 3 ; M lll 61, 22 ), sass' ° (Ja V 401, 27 '), so ° (Mp lll 411, 22 ), ses'ū ° (Ps lV 165, 7 ); — — ° -jāta , mfn., misery-stricken, miserable, Nidd ll 266, 5 (īti-jāte ~e upasagga-jāte, ad Sn 1123 santāpa-jāte; = ādīnava- jāte, Nidd-a ll 83, 23 ); — ° -nīvaraṇa , mfn., warding off misfortune; ifc. ( a ) kat'ū °, kat'ū~tā (Pj ll 33, 11, 14 ).
NCP: masculine a sudden or grievous accident, calamity, misfortune; violence, oppression.

upaddaveti.p: [Upaddava+i+ti] (kri) CL=7 [Moga, 5-kaṇḍa, 10, 12-suta.] He makes trouble or misfortune.
a: ဥပဒ္ဒဝေတိ(ကြိ)
မောဂ်၊ ၅-ကဏ္ဍ၊ ၁ဝ၊ ၁၂-သုတ်။ ဥပဒ္ဒဝနာမ်ပုဒ်နောင် ကရဓာတ်အနက်၌ ဣပစ္စည်းသက်၊ ဣကို ဧပြု] ဘေးဥပဒ်-ဘေးအန္တရာယ်-ကိုပြု၏။

ဥပဒ္ဒဝေတိ（ကြိ）

DOP: upaddaveti pr. 3 sg. [ denom. from upaddava], is a trouble; is oppressive ; Sv 213, 23 (ativiya me tumhe ~ethā ti) = Ps II 318, 28 ; Dhp-a II 70, 10 (mayhaṃ purohito atimukharo … bahuṃ bhaṇanto maṃ ~eti); — see also upaddavati.
CPD: upaddaveti , pr. 3 sg. ( denom. of upaddava), to cause a nuisance, trouble, molest, annoy; acariy'upa- jjhāyehi appa-mattakam pi ovadiyamāno ovādaṃ na gaṇhāti, "ativiya me (tumhe) ~ethā" ti vibbhamati ( "you molest me exceedingly" ), Sv 213, 23 = Ps ll 318, 28 (= sukha-vihārassa upaddavam karotha, Ps-pt B e ll 235, 10 ).

upadduta.p: [Upa+du+ta.(upadruta-saṃ)] (ti) CL=7 (A) One who is afflicted. (B) Should be troubled.

P: Upadduta，[pp．of upaddavati] overrun，oppressed，annoyed，overcome，distressed Vin．II，170； III，144，283； S．II，210； IV，29； J．I，26，61，339； II，102； IV，324，494； Pv．II，108； Vism．24 （= apakata）； Miln．279； VvA．311 （aṭṭita +）； PvA．61．an° unmolested PvA．195； anupaddutatta state of not being molested VvA．95．（Page 142）

upadduta：ဥပ-ဒ္ဒုတ （တိ） （တီ-ကိတ်） （ဥပ√ဒု+တ）
တိုက်ခိုက်အပ်သည်။ ဖီးစီးနှိပ်စက်အပ်သည်။
DOP: upaddavati pr. 3 sg. [ S. upadravati], oppresses; assails ; Sp 730, 6 (paripātentī ti ~anti tattha tattha ādhāvitvā uttāsenti palāpenti); Pj II 100, 20 (~atī ti upaddavo, anatthaṃ janento abhibhavati ajjhottharatī ti attho) = Ap-a 178, 27 ; — pp upadduta ( sometimes written upaddūta), mfn. [ S. upadruta], oppressed; tyrannized over; assailed; visited by calamities ; Vin I 15, 14 (Yaso kulaputto udānaṃ udānesi: ~aṃ vata bho upasaṭṭhaṃ vata bho, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se upaddūtaṃ); D II 162, 30 (~ā ca homa idaṃ vo kappati idam vo na kappatī ti, Be, Ce so; Se upaddūtā; Ee wr uppadutā); M III 116, 6 (ayaṃ vuccat’ Ānanda ~o ācariyo ācariyūpaddavena, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se upaddavo); S II 210, 17 (~ā brahmacārī brahmacārūpaddavena); Pv 22:8 (maccherena ~ā); Th 1093 (kāyaṃ imaṃ maccujarāy’ ~aṃ); Ja II 282, 19 (manussā ~ā yācanāya); V 105, 26* (taṃ dāni ajja dohāma khīrakāmeh’ ~ā); Vism 24, 2 (icchāpakatassā ti icchāya apakatassa ~assā ti attho, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se upaddūtassā ti); Sp 1227, 21 (kadāci hi manussā denti kadāci dubbhikkhādīhi ~ā na denti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se upaddūtā); Pj I 158, 1 (dubbhikkhādīhi upaddavehi ~āya Vesāliyā); Ud-a 235, 6 (kāmavitakkādīhi ~-ttā); — anupadduta, mfn. , not assailed; free from distress or calamity ; Vin I 15, 30 (idaṃ kho Yasa anupaddutaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se anupaddūtaṃ); Vv-a 95, 25 (saṅkilesadhammehi anupaddutattā); Pv-a 195, 16 (kenaci anupadduto mātu aṅke viya sukhaṃ supi); It-a I 61, 26 (catūhi yogehi khemaṃ anupaddutan ti yogakkhemaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee anūpaddūtan ti); — ati-upadduta, mfn. , very oppressed ; Mp IV 11, 4 ; — see also upaddaveti.
CPD: upadduta , mfn. ( sa. upadruta, pp. upa + dru], assailed, harrassed, vexed, troubled, afflicted; sabbaṃ hi taṃ jāti-jarāy' ~aṃ, Ja lV 494, 5* ( ct. = niccaṃ pīḷitaṃ); kāyaṃ imaṃ maccu-jarāy' ~aṃ, Th 1093 ( = pīḷitaṃ, Th-a lll 151, 27 ); sabbaṃ, bhikkhave, ~aṃ, S lV 29, 12 (Spk ll 365, 19 : anekâghena upa- hataṃ); sabbo ~o loko, Bv ll 172 (Bv-a 116, 18 : upahato vyadhito); ( contemplating his sleeping harem ) Yaso kulaputto udānaṃ udānesi: ~aṃ vata bho, upassaṭṭhaṃ vata bho, Vin l 15, 14 ( quoted Mp l 403, 25; Th-a l 243, 21 ) ≠ Ja l 61, 29 ( of bodhisatta); sabbe aniccā ti-bhavā ~ā, Th 1133 (Th-a lll 159, 11 : jāti-ādīhi rāgâdīhi kilesehi ca ~ā); attano dukkhena ~ā niddaṃ na upemi, Dhp-a lll 322, 6 ; aṭṭo aṭṭito ~o maraṇa-dukkhena bādhito, Vv-a 311, 17 ; ~o bhayena āyu-saṅkhāraṃ visajjesi, Spk lll 254, 6 ; Cp-a 37, 8 and Pj l 161, 14 see s. v. upaddava; rogen' amhi ~o, Spk lll 57, 18 ; āpo-dhātuyā ~aṃ disvā, ll 152, 25 ; kucchivāta-sīsavāta-kaṇṇavātâdīhi nicc'~ā, 153, 20 ; dukkha-samphassehi parihato ~o, Ud-a 209, 11 ; (cak- khuṃ) timira-kācâdīhi ~aṃ, Spk l 180, 16 ; khīra- kāmeh' ~ā, Ja V 105, 26 ( ct.: adhammika-rañño puri- sehi); upaṭṭhāka-kulaṃ corehi ~aṃ hoti, Vin lll 67, 10; manussā ~ā (bhikkhūnaṃ) yācanāya, ~ā viññat- tiyā, lll 144, 32 ; bhikkhū ~ā honti āgantuka-gami- kānaṃ senâsanaṃ paññāpentā ( "harrassed with pro- viding lodgings" ), ll 170, 5 ; ( monks exasperated by the Buddha's directions: ) ~ā ca mayaṃ homa "idaṃ vo kappati, idaṃ vo na kappati", 285, 1 = D ll 162, 30 ( E e w. r. uppadutā); assailed by passion, conceit etc. : . . . mucchati kāmayati, . . . ayaṃ vuccati ~o ācariyo . . . ~o antevāsī . . . ~o brahmacārī, M lll 116, 6 — 117, 9 ; ~ā brahmacārī, S ll 210, 17 (Spk ll 174, 18 ); ifc. an°.
